title: Secure AI Code Library — Framework Spec Sheet
description: JSON Schema for files under registry/framework-specs/*.spec.yaml. Framework spec sheets carry framework-specific metadata that language rules cannot infer (CSRF middleware names, default cookie settings, template autoescape defaults, secret-loading conventions). They MUST extend an existing language rule via 'extends'.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier; matches the filename without .spec.yaml.

summary.description: Layer 1 always-on surface. <=300 chars. Same constraint as rule summaries (per ADR 0005).

min_version.description: Optional minimum framework version this spec applies to.

extends.description: OPTIONAL. Per-language rule ID this spec extends. Framework spec sheets typically extend the corresponding per-language rule (e.g. spring-boot extends java-security).

globs.description: File patterns indicating this framework is in use (e.g. ['pom.xml', 'build.gradle', '**/*.java']).

security_relevant_defaults.description: Framework-specific defaults that affect security posture. Examples: csrf_middleware name, session_cookie_secure_default boolean, template_autoescape default, secret_loading_convention string.

authoritative_refs.description: URLs or named references to authoritative security docs (OWASP cheat sheet, vendor security docs, CIS benchmark). Must be on docs/SOURCES.md allowlist.

applicable_rules.description: Cross-language and per-language rule IDs that compose with this framework spec. CI cross-link lint validates each ID exists.

subagent_hints.description: Per-subagent extra checks that go beyond what the rules express. The coding-standards-reviewer subagent loads this object when the framework is detected.

content.description: OPTIONAL. Layer 2 on-demand surface. Markdown body if the spec ships additional guidance beyond structured fields.
